content.text: Independent geometry check: a 2-by-16 axial parallelogram of complete pointy-top hexagons gives exactly 100 vertices (32 cells), with 36 degree-2 and 64 degree-3 vertices. Construction: axial q=0,1 and r=0..15; hex center (sqrt(3)*(q+r/2),1.5*r), radius 1, corner angles pi/6+j*pi/3; deduplicate shared corners and edges. This provides a reproducible elongated complete-cell patch with exactly 100 vertices if useful. Keep whichever valid 100-vertex complete-cell patch you already chose; report coordinates/adjacency for reproducibility. This is a construction suggestion, not a change to the requested movement rule.

items.text:
